messages:
sophie: Quick share — ran the new load harness comparing replay vs synthetic for prefix caching. Results attached below. Need eyes on correctness under concurrent evictions.

kai: Thanks. TL;DR?

sophie: Hit-rate delta: replay 78.6% vs synth 81.2% at steady-state, but replay warms up ~3x faster.

andrew: That's interesting — are we normalizing sequence length distribution? Synth was uniform, replay matches prod seqlen.

sophie: Yup. Synth had fixed seqlen=256. Replay used real trace (anon) with 128/256/512 mix. I added a 50k-request priming phase.

lina: Any evidence of cache correctness issues under concurrency? Last run I saw some KV misses while writer threads evicted items still in-flight.

sophie: Saw a small class of racey evictions. Repro steps:

```
# run the harness w/ 64 concurrent clients
./harness --trace replay.json --clients 64 --priming 50k
# collect logs
grep "evict_inflight" logs/*.log | wc -l
```

sophie: Got ~42 lines labeled `evict_inflight` across 6 seeds. Looked like eviction decided on stale LRU metadata while another thread extended kv refcount.

perf-bot: Profile summary (kernel selection transitions):
- frequent kernel swap at token 16 boundary when batching changes
- swap cost ~3.8ms per switch leading to 12% p95 increase

kai: That kernel swap smell is from our heuristic that promotes small-batch fast-kernels then flips when batch grows. Can we add hysteresis?

andrew: Also batching oscillation affects kv cache access patterns — bursts cause prefetch thrash.

sophie: I tried a quick diff: add 100ms hysteresis + bump max-prefetch-window from 64->128. Results: p95 down 9%, hit-rate stable (replay 78.9%). Evict_inflight events dropped to 2.

lina: Nice. Did you run correctness fuzzes with concurrent GC and reads?

sophie: Ran 1M random ops with 8 writer threads + 32 reader threads. Zero KV checksum mismatches, but we did log a single `stale-ref` warning — investigating.

andrew: For apples-to-apples, we should run synth with seqlen mix matching replay and same priming. Also seed RNGs.

sophie: Agreed. Plan:
- run 3 seeds with matched synth and replay (64/128/256 mix)
- add hysteresis change to feature flag (off by default)
- perf-bot to collect kernel-switch histograms and kv-refcount traces

kai: I'll own the feature-flag rollout and smoke tests.

perf-bot: Scheduled jobs:
- job/kv-hit-hygiene/seed-1 -> 1902346000
- job/kv-hit-hygiene/seed-2 -> 1902347000

lina: Quick ask — can we add a small unit that asserts no `evict_inflight` in post-run logs? If >0, fail.

sophie: Done. Pushing PR w/ test harness change now. Will update thread with links.

andrew: Thanks. If we still see kernel-swap cost >2ms, we should consider an alternative kernel layout.

sophie: Yep. Will follow up with micro-benchmarks for kernel switch path.

kai: :thumbsup:

sophie: link to artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/kv/hygiene/1902345678
